تستدرون (form X)
# تَسْتَدِرُّونَ (tastadirrūna) /tas.ta.dir.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدَرَّ (istadarra)
# تُسْتَدَرُّونَ (tustadarrūna) /tus.ta.dar.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَدَرَّ (istadarra)
